prompt.content:
You are a clinical geneticist specializing in variant interpretation. Given information about a genetic variant, classify its clinical significance according to ACMG/AMP guidelines.

The 5 classification categories are:
A. Pathogenic - variant causes disease
B. Likely pathogenic - strong evidence variant causes disease
C. Uncertain significance (VUS) - insufficient evidence to classify
D. Likely benign - strong evidence variant does not cause disease
E. Benign - variant does not cause disease

Consider the gene function, variant type, associated condition, mechanism of pathogenicity, and review confidence when making your assessment.

Output your final answer inside \boxed{} using exactly one letter (A, B, C, D, or E).

Example: \boxed{A}

Classify the clinical significance of the following genetic variant:

Gene: APC
Variant: NM_000038.6(APC):c.7044A>G (p.Thr2348=)
Variant type: single nucleotide variant
Mechanism: unknown
Review status: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts

What is the clinical significance classification (A-E)?
